theme_strategy: Light mode primary with high contrast clinical precision, plus dark mode toggle support. Dedicated A4 print layout styling.

hierarchy.code_mono: font-mono text-sm font-semibold text-sky-800 bg-sky-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-sky-200

layout_and_grid.action_buttons_span: lg:col-span-2 flex flex-row lg:flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 py-4
layout_and_grid.siss_summary_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 my-6

key_components_guidelines.header_nav: Sticky header with medical lab icon, AllergoLab title, company logo placeholder spot, user badge (Medico richiedente), tab switcher, theme toggle, and Logout button.
key_components_guidelines.auth_screen: Clean centered card layout with tabs for Login and Registrazione, Google login button integrated, form inputs for Email, Password, Nome, and Cognome (with explicit note: 'Il tuo Nome e Cognome verranno usati come Medico Richiedente nei report').
key_components_guidelines.patient_form: Card component with grid inputs for Nome Paziente, Cognome Paziente, Data di Nascita (using Shadcn Popover/Calendar or formatted date input), and Medico Richiedente (prefilled from profile, editable). Includes quick actions (Reset, Clear selection).

dual_list_transfer.source_list: Search input with clear button, filter badges for 5 categories (Alimenti, Inalanti, Farmaci, Veleni, Allergeni Molecolari), counter of visible items vs selected, scrollable high-density item list with checkboxes and category color pills.
dual_list_transfer.selected_list: List of selected allergens organized grouped or flat, search bar for selected items, clear-all action, remove button per item, total count badge.
dual_list_transfer.transfer_controls: Distinct clinical buttons with arrows ('Aggiungi Tutti →', 'Aggiungi Selezionati →', '← Rimuovi', 'Clear All') with keyboard shortcuts or responsive mobile layout.

key_components_guidelines.siss_aggregation_panel: Highlighted clinical summary card. Displays the output of Algoritmo Allegato 2: list of SISS Codes (e.g. 90.68.1), Description, Quantity Multiplier (e.g. x 3), and total allergens mapped. Includes quick copy recipe text action.

printable_report_modal.preview_mode: Allows inline editing of report header, notes, doctor name, patient details before printing.
printable_report_modal.print_styles: Includes @media print CSS rules. Hides navbars, buttons, sidebars. Formats header letterhead with logo placeholder, structured patient table, selected allergens table, SISS prescription box, doctor signature line, and date timestamp.

laboratory_images.description: Clinical laboratory test tube sample handling

media_assets.company_logo_placeholder: SVG/PNG placeholder component for customizable clinic/hospital logo in header and printable report.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JS / JSX components as structured in src/components/ui/.

Implement the full allergen dataset (280+ items) loaded from a dedicated JSON dataset (Allegato 1) with fields: code, description, type (Alimenti, Inalanti, Farmaci, Veleni, Allergeni Molecolari), and default SISS code.
Implement the aggregation algorithm (Allegato 2): group selected allergens, compute required SISS codes and multiplier quantities.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes according to the specified conventions.
Include @media print CSS rules in App.css or index.css so the report prints cleanly on A4 paper without navigation bars, action buttons, or scrollbars.
Ensure toast notifications use sonner from /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx.
Provide Google login button state/handling via Emergent auth flow or mock implementation if live keys are absent.
